title: Vertical Head - SCM Operations , S&OP and Import/Export
location: Parel Office 27th floor, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
jobDescription:
Group Company: Bajaj Electricals Limited

Designation: Manager – Demand Planning

Office Location: Mumbai (HQ)

Position Description:


Analytically driven demand planning role owning end-to-end SKU-level forecasting across Trade and Alternate channels, leading the monthly S&OP consensus cycle, and driving forecast accuracy improvement through statistical rigor and cross-functional collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities:


Develop SKU-level statistical baseline forecasts using time-series methods; track and improve WMAPE and bias

Own demand planning across General Trade, Modern Trade, E-Commerce, and Alternate/Institutional channels

Lead monthly S&OP cycle — baseline generation, sales input collection, demand-supply reconciliation, and leadership review

Analyse promotional impact and seasonal indices to refine demand plans

Execute NPI demand planning using analogous SKU data and cross-functional market intelligence

Identify and resolve inventory risks (excess, slow-moving, obsolete); coordinate liquidation to protect working capital

Maintain and optimise planning system parameters (Anaplan); ensure data integrity across SKU categories


Additional Responsibilities:

Prepare and present executive dashboards and S&OP review decks to Senior Manager / DGM / Business Head level

Drive digitalisation of planning processes — replace manual/legacy models with automated, scalable tools

Act as primary demand signal interface between Sales, Category, Finance, and Supply teams

Coach and mentor junior planners; build capability within the planning function


Reporting Designation: Lead / DGM – Supply Chain

Reporting Department: Supply Chain / Operations

Educational Qualifications Preferred

Category: Post Graduate

Field Specialization: Supply Chain Management / Operations Management

Degree: MBA / PGDM

Academic Score: 60% and above / 6.0 CGPA and above

Institution Tier: Tier 1 / Tier 2 preferred


Required Certifications: APICS CPIM or CSCP (preferred, not mandatory)

Required Trainings: S&OP / IBP process training; Anaplan model building; Statistical forecasting methods


Required Work Experience

Industry: FMCG / Consumer Electronics / FMEG (at least one mandatory; cross-industry preferred)

Role: Demand Planning / Supply Chain Planning / S&OP

Years of Experience: 4–6 years relevant experience


Key Performance Indicators:

Forecast Accuracy (WMAPE) — absolute level and trend improvement

Forecast Bias — sustained near-zero bias across channels

S&OP cycle adherence — on-time completion of baseline, consensus, and review milestones

Inventory health — reduction in excess / slow-moving / obsolete stock value

NPI forecast accuracy at 4-week and 8-week post-launch


Required Competencies:

Stakeholder influence and executive communication

Cross-functional collaboration (Sales, Finance, Supply, Category)

High ownership and accountability

Structured problem-solving under ambiguity

Continuous improvement and process redesign mindset

Coaching and mentoring junior planners


Required Knowledge:

End-to-end Supply Chain Planning and S&OP / IBP governance

Channel-specific demand behaviour across GT, MT, E-Commerce, Institutional

Statistical forecasting methods: time-series, intermittent demand, seasonal decomposition

Inventory management principles: safety stock, DOH norms, replenishment logic

Promotional and seasonal demand modelling


Required Skills:

Advanced Excel (SUMIFS, SUMPRODUCT, dynamic arrays, Power Query) — mandatory

Anaplan (Demand Planning / S&OP modules)

Python or R for forecasting models and workflow automation

SQL for ERP data extraction and aggregation

SAP MM/SD module familiarity

Tableau or Power BI for executive dashboards

ML demand sensing platforms — good to have



Required Abilities

Physical: Standard office-based; ability to work across time zones for global S&OP calls if required

Other: Strong analytical thinking; ability to manage multiple planning cycles simultaneously under tight deadlines
